body.text: a staged power interruption in Sector 4
. Automated systems initiated lockdown. Casualties as of this filing:

.

Recovery status: MTF request DENIED pending review. Site is operating under Autonomous Containment Doctrine — all floors sealed, all personnel classed as expended assets until recontainment.

The interruption was not accidental. Power logs show a manual override from the Director's terminal eleven minutes before failure, and an outbound message to O5-█ reading only: 'It is deeper than we reported.' Refer to standing order GLASS COFFIN.
